title: Cache invalidation on price update
spec: Catalog(prices) holds non-negative integer prices in cents keyed by SKU strings. price(sku) returns the current price and raises KeyError for an unknown SKU. quote(order) returns the sum of price times quantity for a list of (sku, quantity) pairs. update_price(sku, cents) sets a new price, raising ValueError when cents is negative; every later price() or quote() call must reflect the new price. This change adds caching: the counter reads counts accesses to the underlying price table, and each SKU must be read from the table at most once between two updates of that SKU.
target_defect: update_price does not invalidate the cached entry, so later price() and quote() calls return the old price.
author_rationale: Cache prices so repeated quotes stop re-reading the price table.
limitations: Synthetic module written by the repository's AI engineering agent after the November 2026 development pilot saturated corpus v1, before any model reviewed it. Designed around omissions, cross-function effects and edge cases stated in the contract. Not a natural pull request; correct means conforming to the stated contract and supplied checks.
